title: The world is made of Fabulous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Tracen Academy, diamonds in the
rough from every walk of life
gather in one
place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And of those gemstones, one foreign jewel
is currently shining
brilliantly for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, our scrimmage has started! ♪ Make
sure you keep up, Dober!
Let's begin with
a light warm-up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Everything's in place. The condition of the track, the nature surrounding it, and of course—the crowd with their eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Tch... She practically leapt out of that
gate! And what's up with that
acceleration
of hers?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's running that fast while taking in the
sights?! How are we in the
same
generation?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Dober, the real race starts now.
Here I go—haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Tch!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So that's Seeking the Pearl. I've heard
good things about her, but to
outpace a
prodigy of the Mejiro family like that truly
is impressive.

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. If this is what she can do in a
scrimmage, then we've got a lot
to look
forward to in the upcoming tryouts. You
think so too, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her talent, I could see her making a
G1 race debut in record
time. I wouldn't
be surprised if every trainer here wanted
to scout her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl... Just what kind of
Umamusume are you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! How much do you ladies and gentlemen know? About this fabulous world we live in, I mean!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you've laid your eyes on it before.
Where did I put it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Found it—this globe! Have you good
people seen every nook and
cranny of this
world?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...A globe? I'm not sure where this wacky speech is going, but it does give me a sense of her character.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Though I was born in the USA, I moved to
many different countries as
a child. Thanks
to that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was able to meet and interact with many
different cultures and
people.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
Little Umamusume, take a good look. This
is the palace, dear.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's positively excellent! ♪

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
If you want to live somewhere like here in
the future, then you have
to work hard,
okay? I know you can do it, dear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
These countless experiences helped grant
me a goal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that goal is to become an
Umamusume who shines brilliantly
enough
to rival the landmarks, traditions, and
confections of every
country!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I will shine bright enough for everyone to
see. I'll prove it through my

racing—maybe! In other words—definitely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, Pearl? Are you sure that...
"confections" is what you meant? And
you
do know that "maybe" and "definitely"
mean different things,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl is brimming with
confidence and has a strong sense
of
humor to boot. Every trainer here has set
their sights on scouting
her.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, Seeking the Pearl! Won't you
become my trainee? I promise
to help you
achieve speeds you can only dream of!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
No, become my trainee! I'm currently
researching memorable races.
Together,
we can aim to run in a way that captivates
your fans! How
about it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. Achieving new top
speeds, running to captivate
the fans...
Both sound appealing. But that said...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the offers from accomplished trainers
haven't moved her one bit.
Seems like
grabbing her attention will be an arduous
task.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Doesn't anyone here have a more, I don't know, amazing dream? Hey, the trainer over there—yes you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Do you have anything to propose?
Preferably a dream so fantastic, so

gorgeous, I'll be hooked in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a mischievous look on her face, she
turns to face me. She
probably picked me
on a whim, but I'm not about to pass up an

opportunity like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... A dream that lives up to the
talent she showed off in the
scrimmage just
now...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh? Upside-down, you say... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Though I am a world-class pearl, I'm also
unpolished and unrefined.
And you're the
same—a rookie trainer, if I'm not mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Despite that, you're able to spout
grandiose lines like, "Let's turn the
racing
world upside-down." Do you even have a
plan to achieve that
goal?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ♪ So you didn't think that far. I
appreciate the enthusiasm...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But I'm looking for a concrete map that
can guide me forwards. Yes, I
wanted to
see your very own world map.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She immediately saw through the baseless
words I blurted out in a
panic.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey trainers! ♪ I appreciate the love
you're showing me, but how
about you try
to scout me after you've seen me run for
real?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And by that, I mean the tryouts! I'll pull off a gorgeous victory there! Even she won't stand a chance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For an instant, her expression turns
serious. But before I can even
blink, she's
back to her cheery and confident
demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who could be the mysterious rival that
Seeking the Pearl is referring
to?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Pearl! Let's have a good race out
there today, all right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Taiki. As always, the aura
you emit is enough to shake
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn tootin'—I'm in tip-top condition! The
Kentucky Express don't
stop for nobody!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can imagine. An ordinary Umamusume
could never hope to catch up.
But the
word "impossible" doesn't exist in my
dictionary!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Scratch that—I threw away every
dictionary the moment I was born! As
they
say, a single action triumphs over a
thousand words!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
So it's going to be Seeking the Pearl
versus Taiki Shuttle, huh? This'll
be an
exciting clash between two American-born
superstars.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Definitely. Looking solely at speed, the
two of them are already on
par with the
previous generation of runners. I'm curious
to see who
wins.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, the winner will be yours truly. I'll
win this race and prove my
potential to
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you're looking at a
world-class pearl! No matter how fast
Taiki
may run, my brilliance shall never be
clouded ov—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: H-hm? I remain unclouded...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But the sky cannot say the same. Who
could've expected this sudden
shower?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sudden downpour drenches the
runners and the ground beneath
them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, this American showdown is now
set to kick off on a heavy
track.
